text.p: Pakistan fast bowler Waqar Younis faces a fitness test on Thursday morning before the second test against New Zealand.
Pakistan, who lost the first test by 44 runs, are also likely to play seamer Mohammad Zahid on a pitch expected to favour the pace bowlers.
New Zealand have named an unchanged side for the match.
"All test playing countries go through bad patches and this is something which can happen to any top team," said Pakistan captain Saeed Anwar. "They all have the capacity to win on the day."

Pakistan (from) - Saeed Anwar (captain), Zahoor Elahi, Inzaman-ul-Haq, Ejaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Mohammad Wasim, Moin Khan, Waqar Younis, Mushtaq Ahmed, Mohammad Zahid, Shaid Nazir, Mohammad Akram, Saqlain Mushtaq.
New Zealand - Bryan Young, Justin Vaughan, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Nathan Astle, Mark Greatbatch, Chris Cairns, Lee Germon, Dipak Patel, Simon Doull.
